name: berigame
description: Let ChatGPT play a character on the BeriGame island: gather, craft, trade and fight bosses while you watch a live map.

interface.shortDescription: Let ChatGPT play BeriGame for you
interface.longDescription: BeriGame is a cosy shared island game. Your assistant joins as a character, gathers berries, crafts tools, trades with other players and joins boss fights, while a live map in the sidebar or chat shows where it is and what it carries.
defaultPrompt: @BeriGame join the game and play toward the first goal.
